verdict.rationale: The patent filing page tells applicants before they start that they need GOV.UK One Login credentials, either existing or newly set up. It also publishes a paper or email fallback, so the credential wall is visible up front for patents. But it does not spell out the identity-proofing steps within One Login, and the trade mark filing guidance in the pack states no account or credential requirements at all. Missing for 10: an explicit list of identity-proofing or verification steps, any stated account or credential requirements for the trade mark filing path, and independent or hands-on corroboration that no further walls appear mid-flow.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow

citations.quote: You'll need your One Login details if you have them, or you can set them up. File online
The identity wall on the patent filing path is a credential account, stated before you start
You can fill in a form and email or post it to the IPO.
